strings.name: Tom Hanks
strings.summary: Hanks entered film through stage work and television comedy, gaining prominence with Splash and Big. Philadelphia and Forrest Gump brought consecutive Best Actor Oscars. His long collaborations with Spielberg and others include war-history productions, while he voices Woody in Toy Story. His career spans popular comedy, drama and television production.
